evidence.reason: The alleged inconsistency requires a caller to pass accessor-backed or otherwise mutable top-level packet properties, which the finding itself concedes. The supplied code treats the packet as an internal plain-data record; no caller, type, test, or contract evidence shows such accessors exist, so repeated reads of ordinary string fields are not an existing correctness defect. The revision-identity portion is also contradicted by the local `revision` capture used at lines 409 and 426. This is a hardening suggestion, not a demonstrated bug in intended behavior.
